name: A Carved Narrative - Explore the Craft of Woodcut Printmaking
description:
Humans have always felt the need to tell stories - to make sense of the world,
to connect and to remember. It’s how we share what we’ve seen and felt.
Woodcut printmaking is one of the oldest ways of doing just that - carving
images and text on wooden blocks and creating prints that could travel, be
shared and seen by many.****

****  

In this hands-on experience, discover the joy of transforming a **simple block
of wood into your own striking art print**. Guided by a professional
printmaker, explore every step of the process from design transfer and carving
to inking and printing while tracing the centuries-old journey of this deeply
absorbing craft.

name: Dim Sum Making - A Community Cooking & Dining Experience
description:
Drawing inspiration from community dining and the pleasures of deep diving
into the art of cooking, this experience helps you engage all five senses when
you're in the kitchen.  
  
**_The theme for this cookalong is Asian cuisine - Dim Sum making._**

**Cookalong** : Learn to make and steam dim sums from scratch, options
include; Pan fried chicken dim sum (non- veg), spicy broccoli with cream
cheese dim sum (veg), vegetable fried wonton (veg).

**Menu** : A welcome drink and the dim sums you make during the experience.

**Note:** The cookalong includes both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options.

name: Glass Gardens - A Terrarium Making Experience
description:
Imagine our world, shrunk to fit inside a bottle. In 19th century England, a
chance encounter with a tenacious fern sparked an idea, that of a terrarium.
Today, these self-sustaining havens encapsulate a tiny piece of the great
outdoors, indoors, and are a testament to human ingenuity and nature's
resilience.

_**This immersive experience delves into the world of terrariums and plant
care. Participants get to make and take home their own terrarium.**_

_**Note: Participants will create a closed Terrarium in a Jar with tropical
plants.**_

name: Summit Seekers - A Rock Climbing Experience
description:
Stemming from an age-old human desire to reach new heights, rock climbing is
beyond just a fitness ritual. This beginner-friendly rock climbing experience
draws inspiration from climbing pioneers, the unending human quest to problem-
solve better and design thinking to equip you with the skills and confidence
to embark on your own climbing journey. Join us and discover a sport steeped
in storytelling, where the upward journey is as beautiful as the summit.

name: Wonders of Horology - The Art of Fine Watchmaking
description:
Delve into the enchanting world of watchmaking, and gain a deeper
understanding about the stellar craftsmanship and intricate detailing that go
into the making of luxe time pieces.

This experience will have you discover the nuanced art and science of watch-
making, and help you look at time from a whole new perspective under the
guidance of an expert horologist.  

_**The experience includes navigating through various components of Time
Making, the intricacies of Fine Watchmaking in an immersive visual journey
under the guidance of an expert.**_

name: The Craft of Mixology - Making & Mastering A Fine Cocktail
description:
Discover the world of cocktails and spirits and learn how to balance your own
cocktail concoction under the guidance of expert mixologists.

The experience will include a quick introduction to different spirits,
cocktail making techniques, bar equipment, interesting garnishing tips along
with various stories and myths around cocktails and spirits.  
  
Note: The experience is open to participants aged 21 and above. **Drink
responsibly.**

name: Sommelier's Secrets - Decoding Fine Wines
description:
The origins of wine remain shrouded in mystery. Civilizations have flourished
and generations have evolved since, but we have barely managed to decode the
intricacies of one of the oldest alcoholic beverages known to mankind.

This wine tasting trail will take you on an immersive journey of tasting and
appreciating 6 fabulous wines, sprinkled with the most interesting stories to
help you understand the culture and nuances of the spirit.

**This Wine Tasting will comprise a guided tasting of 6 wines from around the
world with varying styles and structures, emphasising on sustainable wine
making practices.**

name: Oasis Of Scents - Artisanal Perfume Making
description:
An ode to the masterful craft of perfume making and the country's best noses,
this experience will have you develop a discerning sense of smell, understand
the nuances of perfumery as a science and art, as well as how fragrances
passively contribute to our overall experiences to create a lasting memory.

_**The experience includes navigating through various fragrance notes to
formulate your own customised bottle of perfume, under the guidance of an
expert**_

name: The Buttery Bake - A Pastry Making Experience
description:
Did you know pastries existed even before the English language itself? It’s a
centuries-old craft where simple ingredients like flour, butter and sugar come
together to create a range of textures from light and flaky to crisp and
crumbly.

At its core, pastry is a type of dough used to create the base of many sweet
and savoury bakes. While the crust brings structure, it’s the combination of
texture and filling that makes these dishes so widely loved.

Step into the world of buttery crusts in this hands-on baking experience,
where you’ll explore both sweet and savoury classics from scratch. Guided by
an expert, you’ll work with pastry dough, learn the fundamentals behind
texture and technique, and bake a savoury quiche alongside a classic apple
crumble.

name: The Leather Lab - A Leathercraft Experience
description:
Leathercraft is over 7000 years old, making it one of humanity’s oldest
practices. What once served as a tool for survival has evolved into a craft
that is rooted in patience, attention and the art of making something with our
own hands.

In an age of fast fashion and disposability, shaping leather by hand reminds
us of the value of durability, of creating fewer but more meaningful things
and of honouring natural materials.

In this experience, step into the lineage of leather - understand the
material, work through each stage by hand and leave with a leather cardholder
you’ve shaped, stitched and made your own.

name: The Italian Dumpling - A Gnocchi Making Experience
description:
We often think of gnocchi as purely Italian, but its story goes further back.

Gnocchi traces its origins to ancient Roman times, where these dumplings made
from flour and water were part of everyday meals.

It wasn’t until the 16th century, when potatoes arrived in Italy, that gnocchi
became the soft, pillowy bites we love today. Passed down through generations
and across regions, gnocchi evolved into countless variations, each bite a
taste of tradition and comfort.

**Discover the story, craft, and flavours of gnocchi in this hands-on
experience. Learn dough-making, shaping, saucing, and plating this Italian
classic just as it’s done in Italy.**

****

**Note: The cookalong includes only vegetarian option.**

name: Treasures From The Estates - Coffee Brewing & Tasting
description:
Switch from coffee enthusiast to aficionado in this unique coffee appreciation
experience. Delve into the world of premium Indian Estate Coffees, and learn
the nuances of brewing and tasting single-origin brews, including a cold one.

This immersive experience helps you develop a keen sense of understanding
about unique Indian coffees and what makes them special. We will cover three
brewing methods - AeroPress, FrenchPress and Pour Over.

name: Hula Harmony - Explore Movement Through Hooping
description:
A toy that was once designed for recreation, hula hooping gradually took the
world by a storm, starting with the United States in the late 1950s. Today
hula hooping is not just a playful activity, but also a form of exercise and
artistic expression. A cultural phenomenon, influencing music, fashion, and
dance.

**_This experience will involve a guided introduction to hula hooping, tricks
and transitions and flow choreography through some fun activities!_**

name: Ink & Intentions - A Brush Pen Calligraphy Experience
description:
Writing is one of our most powerful mediums for expressing thoughts and
emotions. When we put our feelings into words, they reveal layers of meaning
and interpretation for ourselves and for others. But what if those words could
become a form of visual expression too?

Calligraphy, the art of beautiful writing, adds depth, character and intention
to the written word. Through varying pressures, rhythms and movement, a brush
pen can create strokes that are bold, delicate, fluid or expressive.

Turn your thoughts into visual art in this immersive calligraphy experience.
As you learn foundational brush pen techniques, explore thick and thin stroke
variations and build letters from individual forms, you'll begin to experience
writing as a mindful, almost meditative practice. Develop a new relationship
with the written form, and create a personalised piece that is entirely your
own.

name: The Matcha Journey - An Exploration Into The World of Matcha
description:
If there’s one drink people always have an opinion about, it’s matcha. Some
love it instantly, others grow into it. Unlike most teas, matcha isn’t
infused. You’re drinking the whole leaf, finely ground into powder, which is
why the flavour, colour and energy feel so distinct. It’s also what sets it
apart from most drinks and why it has become such a global favourite.

  

But within the bright green bowl lies a deeper story shaped by centuries of
Japanese tea culture, careful farming and a ritual that values attention and
simplicity.

  

**In this experience, you’ll explore matcha through tasting, brewing and
conversation with a seasoned tea connoisseur. You’ll also compare it with
coffee, looking at differences in energy, focus and everyday ritual. Leave
with a clearer understanding of Japanese tea culture and a deeper appreciation
for the craft behind every bowl of matcha.**

name: Echoes of Calm - An Immersive Sound Bath Experience
description:
The use of sound for healing dates back thousands of years to various ancient
cultures. Indigenous peoples have long used drums, chanting, and other
instruments for ceremonial and therapeutic purposes. These practices were
often tied to spiritual rituals and were believed to have healing properties.

This immersive sound bath experience is built on the enduring belief in the
power of sound, and sets you on the path to healing, relaxation, and spiritual
growth.

name: Spin City - The Artistry of Pole
description:
While the origin story of pole art is multifaceted, spanning across multiple
cultures and time periods, today pole dance is regarded as an art form
celebrated for its fusion of athleticism, grace, and creativity.

_**This experience is an immersion into the art of pole movement, looking
beyond its association with strip clubs to embracing it as a wonderful way to
move and stay fit.**_

name: Treasures From The Estates - Coffee Brewing & Tasting
description:
Switch from coffee enthusiast to aficionado in this unique coffee appreciation
experience. Delve into the world of premium Indian Estate Coffees, and learn
the nuances of brewing and tasting single-origin brews, including a cold one.

This immersive experience helps you develop a keen sense of understanding
about unique Indian coffees and what makes them special. We will cover three
brewing methods - AeroPress, FrenchPress and Pour Over.

**_Join us for the Brunch edit. Enjoy Trove’s signature coffee brewing
experience alongside a special breakfast menu curated by Chef Clyde Comello of
Monkey Bar._**

Attendees can opt for either a vegetarian or non-vegetarian set breakfast
menu, which will include all items mentioned below.

  * **Veg Meal:** Chole Bhature, Mini Fruit Bowl, and Mini Muffin.
  * **Non Veg Meal:** Mushroom & Cheese Omelette (with a slice of bread, butter & side salad), Mini Muesli Bowl, and Mini Muffin.

Fresh watermelon juice will be served to all attendees.

name: Chocolate Wonderland - Bean-to-Bar Chocolate Making & Tasting
description:
Indulge in the world of premium couverture chocolates - the real deal - and
get hands on with the basics of artisanal chocolate making.

This delightful experience will have you indulge in premium chocolate sourced
from the best locations, and learn delectable chocolate recipes under the
guidance of expert chocolatiers.

name: A Mini Indulgence - A Cupcake Baking & Icing Experience
description:
Cupcakes first appeared in 1796 when Amelia Simmons’ cookbook referenced “a
light cake to bake in small cups.” What started as a practical way to portion
batter soon evolved into a global favourite, with flavours and techniques
reflecting diverse cultures.

Once a simple teatime treat, these portable cakes have taken over bakeries,
celebrations, and social media, transforming into edible art with intricate
piping, vibrant colours, and rich flavours. Innovations in baking have led to
the infusion of jams, chocolates, and creams into these treats while
preserving their delicate texture.

Immerse yourself in a hands-on Cupcake Baking & Icing Experience, and explore
the art of baking light, fluffy cupcakes from scratch. Learn expert techniques
for icing with precision and creativity, all while indulging in delightful
treats that complement and elevate your creations.  

**Note: The experience includes only eggless option.**

name: The Way of Flowers - Flower Arrangement Experience
description:
Arranging flowers may seem as simple as placing them in water but flower
arrangement invites a deeper appreciation of their beauty - their colours,
forms, textures and the many subtle details they carry.

As you begin to understand the language of flowers, you start working with
them more thoughtfully. It draws attention to seasonality, encourages working
with natural materials, and builds a sensitivity to detail - how stems fall,
how colours interact, and how space is used.

In this experience, you will learn the fundamentals of flower arrangement -
from selecting the right flowers to understanding composition and balance.
Work with a curated selection of blooms, explore different arrangement styles
and create your own piece to take back with you.

name: The Craft of Mixology - Making & Mastering A Fine Cocktail
description:
Discover the world of cocktails and spirits and learn how to balance your own
cocktail concoction under the guidance of expert mixologists.

The experience will include a quick introduction to different spirits,
cocktail making techniques, bar equipment, interesting garnishing tips along
with various stories and myths around cocktails and spirits.  
  
Note: The experience is open to participants aged 21 and above. **Drink
responsibly.**

name: The Woolen Canvas - A Needle Felting Experience
description:
Imagine transforming loose, cloud-like wool into a solid, durable sculpture
without using glue or a single stitch of thread. That is the art of needle
felting.

You start with nothing but a pile of colourful fibres and a specialised barbed
needle. By simply poking the wool repeatedly (called felting), you tangle the
fibers until they lock into place. It is like you are ‘painting with wool’,
building up layers of colour and texture as you go.****

**Come get hands-on with this tactile technique. In this experience, you will
learn to felt a personalised design onto a felt bag, walking away with a
functional piece of art you created.**
